identity: A Jordanian / modern-Arab-history multiple-choice exam bank (تاريخ الأردن، النهضة العربية، مصر محمد علي)، 20 items, 387 tokens. Not prose at all. Each <NL>-delimited paragraph is exactly one MCQ item: a question stem followed immediately by four answer options run together with no punctuation, no option lettering and no line break between the options. Doctrine genre I — the genre that cost me 33.3 F1 in batch 1 because I read it as running prose.
law: Structural, not syntactic. Each item = 1 stem unit + 4 option units, so the sentence unit here is the exam line, not the clause. (1) THE STEM ENDS WHERE THE OPTIONS BEGIN, even mid-construction: a trailing copula (هو / هي), a trailing preposition (أمام، عن), a construct-state head (عهد، أقوال الملك) or a shared head noun awaiting its adjective (اللون، بالعوامل، الجامعة) is a colon in disguise and closes the stem — doctrine H1 / I2. (2) Whatever is SHARED by all four options stays in the stem; only the varying material is an option. (3) EVERY option is its own unit, one word (المذكرات، سعيد، الأحمر) or five (توريث الحكم لابناء محمد علي) — the short-tail rule 0b is suspended in this genre (I3). (4) و that merely coordinates bare nouns inside a stem or an option (رئيس الوزراء والوزراء) is never a boundary (I5, conjunct-weight test). (5) FOUR OPTIONS PER ITEM is the document-wide invariant and is the tie-breaker wherever the option split is ambiguous.
reasoning: GENRE FIRST (checklist item 1). Twenty parallel <NL> blocks, each ending in a run of three to five parallel siblings of the same syntactic type with zero connectives between them — that is the option-list detection signal I4. Confirmed by the four-king option set (الحسين بن طلال / عبدالله الاول / الشريف الحسين بن علي / طلال بن عبدالله) recurring verbatim in five separate items, and by the four-colour set (الابيض / الأسود / الأخضر / الأحمر) recurring in three consecutive items. STEM-END SITES, three sub-patterns, all instances of the colon cut. (a) Dangling copula or preposition: هو@12, هو@30, هو@52, هي@238, هي@343, هو@374, أمام@204, عن@319. The stem is left grammatically incomplete, exactly as in the batch-1 golds '…ولد فيه الملك عبدالله الأول ابن الحسين في مكة المكرمة هو ‖ 1882 م' and '…بحق المال العام ل ‖ مجلسي الأعيان والنواب'. High confidence, free points. (b) Construct-state head: عهد@149 ('عرفت مصر الحرية الاقتصادية منذ عهد ‖ سعيد ‖ عباس ‖ محمد على ‖ اسماعيل') and الملك@290 ('من أقوال الملك ‖ الحسين بن طلال ‖ …'). (c) Shared head noun before four bare adjectives: اللون@71, اللون@82, اللون@93, بالعوامل@185, الجامعة@268. PATTERN (c) IS THE ONE STRUCTURAL GAMBLE IN THIS DOCUMENT. The rival reading is that option 1 is 'اللون الابيض' and the stem ends at لها@70, which would leave options 2-4 as bare adjectives — an asymmetric option set no exam writer produces. The decisive internal proof comes from @290: the four-king option set appears five times in this document and NEVER carries الملك, so in 'من أقوال الملك' the shared head الملك demonstrably belongs to the stem and not to option 1. I transfer that finding to اللون / بالعوامل / الجامعة. Marked med, flagged for doctrine. Note the risk is bounded: if I am wrong the option-internal boundaries @72-@75 etc. still stand and I lose only one FP plus one FN per item. OPTION COUNTING at @109. 'المذكرات مهنتي كالملك حربنا مع اسرائيل ليس سهلا ان تكون ملكا' can be read as three options (with 'المذكرات مهنتي كالملك' as one title) or four. Four, because a three-option item would be the only one in twenty, and because the item asks which is NOT among Hussein's works — المذكرات is the distractor and the other three are real titles. I3 forbids the short-tail brake from rescuing a one-word option. Conversely 'محمد على'@152-153 is ONE option (Muhammad Ali Pasha), not two, which yields the clean four-ruler set سعيد / عباس / محمد على / اسماعيل; splitting it would give five options and break the invariant. THE HARDEST SITE IS THE QUOTED STEM @274-@290. 'لا أقبل إلا أن تكون فلسطين لأهلها للعرب ولا أقبل بالتجزئة ولا أقبل بالانتداب من أقوال الملك' contains three anaphoric لا أقبل predications. Doctrine 0b would absorb a 3-word tail, but 0b is explicitly restricted to NON-PARALLEL fragments, and both B2 ('والبصر إنما يدرك الألوان ‖ والشم يدرك الروائح ‖ والذوق يدرك الطعوم') and E1 ('هذا كلام العجائز ‖ هذا حديث خرافة ‖ هذا مذهب عتيق') state that exact anaphoric parallelism defeats the short-tail rule and forces a cut at every repetition. That is the identical shape here, and checklist item 4 tells me my prior is 7:1 wrong in the merge direction, so I cut @281 (للعرب) and @284 (بالتجزئة). The counter-argument I cannot dismiss is that every other stem in this document is a single undivided unit and the gold may treat an exam stem as atomic regardless of internal clause structure. Confidence lo on both; this is the site I expect the grader to overturn. The attribution phrase 'من أقوال' is NOT given its own unit — it rides on the last quote clause, per the I2 precedent that a dangling stem keeps its trailing function words rather than shedding them. THE MIRROR-IMAGE SITE, @368-@373 in the last item, where I deliberately do NOT cut. 'وعلى إسرائيل أن تنسحب منها' is و plus a new predication with its own subject and PP frame, which §0 would normally cut. I decline: it is 5 words, non-parallel, and buried two levels deep inside لأن inside الذي, both no-cut subordinators; and cutting would strand the incoherent unit 'وعلى إسرائيل أن تنسحب منها هو', which ends on the dangling copula that must close the stem. Short-tail rule 0b applies in full force. Same reasoning leaves لأن@362 uncut. This is not inconsistent with the Q17 decision: there the trigger was exact anaphoric parallelism (B2/E1 override), here there is none. ONE MORE و: 'رئيس الوزراء والوزراء مسؤولون'@193 is bare-noun coordination of two subjects — conjunct-weight test says no cut (I5). LAST: unlike doc_25ed373f8aeb, this document DOES supply <NL> at every item boundary, so the twenty pre-<NL> and final-token boundaries are mandatory and free; all of my genuine risk is concentrated in the stem/option split inside each block, and I have taken 102 boundaries in total, i.e. 5 per item plus the two extra quote-internal cuts.
